summary: Full backend + frontend testing for FloppyData Proxy Gateway. All 9 pytest backend endpoints pass (settings, balance, locations, build, activate, active, test, fetch, history). Frontend E2E: dashboard loads, type tabs switch (residential/mobile/datacenter), search filter works, SELECT US -> Build dialog -> Build & Test returns ALIVE with exit IP, Activate updates Active Proxy card + Architecture Flow, Health Check prints ALIVE+latency, Fetch prints HTTP 200 with matching exit IP, Usage History rows appear, Settings dialog opens with masked key.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (accessibility warning only, non-blocking)

action_items: (optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Build & Settings dialogs to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses synchronous `requests` inside `asyncio.to_thread` - acceptable, but consider httpx.AsyncClient for cleaner async and per-call timeouts.
probe_proxy / fetch_through_proxy timeouts are hardcoded (30s/45s); consider making them configurable via env.
history uses proxy id as _id which prevents same proxy being re-activated twice (insert_one would fail). Consider upsert or generating new history id.
No auth on /api/settings POST - anyone can overwrite the FloppyData key. Acceptable for student demo but note for production.
seed_data_creation: Test cleared history at end of run; active proxy remains set (US residential).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and hit live FloppyData. Rotating residential proxy causes exit_ip to change per build; tests assert presence + alive rather than exact IP. Fetch endpoint routes through active proxy and returns via_proxy.exit_ip. All 9 pytest tests pass in ~7s.
